book.jaymospowers.raiders_tally.page1:
TAKEN

The grey one. Nothing on it. Took it anyway.

The red one. Iron in the ground. Good iron.

The ice one. The clans there fought well. We sang for them after.

The green one. Nothing worth carrying.
book.jaymospowers.raiders_tally.page2:
NEXT

This one. Rich. Soft.

They keep looking up.

Good.
book.jaymospowers.raiders_tally.page3:
Home: —

We do not write that one down any more.
book.jaymospowers.demon_muster.page1:
MUSTER
for the one at the back

The Gloam: four hundred.
The Ash: nine hundred.
The Abyss: what the Abyss would give.
book.jaymospowers.demon_muster.page2:
PROMISED

The light.
Their fields.
Their warm houses, and what was in them.
book.jaymospowers.demon_muster.page3:
CAME HOME

The imps, mostly.
They fly.
book.jaymospowers.demon_muster.page4:
The Master says we do not go up again until we are called.

We have not been called.

Yet.
road.jaymospowers.chrono.echo: End your own echo, for good.
road.jaymospowers.chrono.omen: Find one of the last pilots, and let them talk.
road.jaymospowers.chrono.clock: Spend long enough outside time, then sleep through to morning.
message.jaymospowers.chrono_road.drawing: The pilot presses some folded papers into your hand.
book.jaymospowers.clock_drawings.page1:
SHEET 9

A great wheel, taller than a house, every tooth drawn one by one.

In the margin: every rivet.
book.jaymospowers.clock_drawings.page2:
SHEET 14

The same wheel, small enough to sit in a chest plate.

For the sweepers. They will want to keep time.
book.jaymospowers.clock_drawings.page3:
SHEET 30

A city's streets, with a little mark on every corner where a sweeper stands.

No note.
book.jaymospowers.clock_drawings.page4:
The name at the foot of every sheet has been scraped off with a knife.

The scraping is neat. Whoever did it was in no hurry.
road.jaymospowers.web.crater: Find a meteor crater, and lay hands on what is at its heart.
road.jaymospowers.web.deep: Grow close enough to it that it stops fighting you.
road.jaymospowers.web.white: Heal it while it has you, until it comes out white.
road.jaymospowers.xeno.reader: Find a star-reader at a fallen star, and hear them out.
road.jaymospowers.xeno.moon: Set foot on the Pale Moon.
road.jaymospowers.xeno.forge: Have your band reforged at the star forge.
road.jaymospowers.xeno.hunter: Beat the band hunter, and take his band.
road.jaymospowers.arsenal.place: Mark a place to come back to.
road.jaymospowers.arsenal.future: Pull something through that has not been made yet.
road.jaymospowers.arsenal.pinned: Pin a weapon, so it is you who says what comes.
message.jaymospowers.road.web_memory: Something black leaks from your sleeve onto a blank page, and writes.
message.jaymospowers.road.hunter_orders: Something falls out of his coat as he runs.
message.jaymospowers.road.perrito_handbi: A sheet of paper comes through the rift with it.
book.jaymospowers.web_memory.page1:
Cold.

Dark, for a long time.

Then falling, a long way, and burning.
book.jaymospowers.web_memory.page2:
A hole in the ground. Then hands.

We were hungry. We were always hungry.
book.jaymospowers.web_memory.page3:
Other hands, once. White ones.

He said: Stay.

We stayed.
book.jaymospowers.web_memory.page4:
When he went, what was left of him went out into the world, fine as dust.

Some of it found you.
book.jaymospowers.hunter_orders.page1:
Find the band.

You will know it. It hums when it is near its maker's work.
book.jaymospowers.hunter_orders.page2:
Do not bargain with the wearer. Do not explain.

The old one says it was made to be given. The old one is not the one who sent you.
book.jaymospowers.hunter_orders.page3:
Bring it home.

If you cannot bring it home, do not come home.
book.jaymospowers.perrito_handbill.page1:
LOS PERRITO CITY
NOTICE

Sweepers will keep to their routes during the parade.

Please do not feed the sweepers.
book.jaymospowers.perrito_handbill.page2:
The red and the blue will open the parade at the east bridge.

Bring the children!
book.jaymospowers.perrito_handbill.page3:
(in pencil, across the back)

parade's off. the bridge is the line now.
if you find this don't come
